title: Rum Cream Pie
description: A light, frozen no-bake pie of whipped egg yolks and sugar set with a little gelatin, flavored with rum extract and folded into stiff whipped cream.
instructions: Dissolve 1 tsp gelatin in 1/8 cup (2 tbsp) hot water.
Beat 3 egg yolks and 1/2 cup sugar until light.
Beat the gelatin water into the egg mixture, then let it cool.
Beat 1 cup heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add 1 tbsp rum extract to the egg mixture.
Combine the egg mixture with the whipped cream. Don't overmix, or the whipped cream will become runny.
Pour into a pie dish and freeze until firm.
notes: No crust is listed; macros cover the filling only, so add your crust's macros if you use one. Freeze at least 4 hours (or overnight) before slicing. The egg yolks aren't cooked, so use pasteurized eggs if that's a concern.
